spans.s: ल्यु krt affix यु changed into अन in the sense of an agent applied to the root नन्द् and others (after which it is seen actually used in language); e.g. नन्दनः, दूषण:, साधन:, रोचन: cf. नन्दिग्रहिपचादिभ्यो ल्युणिन्यच:
ल्युट् krt affix अन in the sense of verbal activity as also in the sense of an 'abode' or 'an instrument'; cf.
